description: This file defines in-memory data structures and a singleton database class for managing user, class, and attendance records in an attendance management system.

classes.name: UserRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a user with id, name, email, role, and hashed password.

classes.name: ClassRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a class with id, name, teacher id, and list of student ids.

classes.name: AttendanceRecord
classes.description: Data class representing an attendance record with id, student id, class id, status, and day.

classes.name: MemoryDB
classes.description: Class implementing an in-memory database with dictionaries for users, classes, and attendance records, and a method to generate unique IDs.

methods.name: gen_id
methods.description: Generates a new UUID string for record identification.
